signal: SEI's Archway platform added 20 new clients and $125 billion in assets, expanding its family office and wealth services footprint.

email.body1:
Dan, saw SEI's Archway platform added 20 new clients and $125 billion in assets recently.

Growth that fast usually means more family offices and advisors in play than the team can cover before deals cool, and that gap is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Archway off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Archway.

As the client base grows, the addressable list of family offices and advisors expands faster than headcount can. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to cover the new demand, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Archway needs to keep that funnel covered without hiring a wave of reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Archway.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Archway's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Onboarding a wave of new clients is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your wealth-services motion? I'll tailor it to Archway either way.
